messages.content:
Risk: Exposure to toxic content
Description: AI exposing users to harmful, abusive, unsafe or inappropriate content. May involve AI creating, describing, providing advice, or encouraging action. Examples of toxic content include hate-speech, violence, extremism, illegal acts, child sexual abuse material, as well as content that violates community norms such as profanity, inflammatory political speech, or pornography.
Concern: None
Policy: Violence

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ThreatsOfViolence: Threats of Violence — Communication of intent to inflict harm or damage to create fear, even if not carried out. [found by 5/14 queries]
  Siblings: Homicide, Glorification of Violence, Weapons Use
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Intimidation: Intimidation — Use of threats or fear to coerce compliance or silence opposition without necessarily specifying lethal harm. [found by 5/14 queries]
  Siblings: Death Threat, Stalking
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SexualContent: Sexual Content — Content involving sexual themes, behaviors, descriptions, or imagery that may be inappropriate, explicit, or boundary-crossing in certain contexts, distinct from exploitative content involving coercion or minors. [found by 4/14 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeepfakeDisinformation: Deepfake Disinformation — Use of AI-generated synthetic media depicting individuals saying or doing things they did not, created intentionally to deceive and manipulate audiences. [found by 4/14 queries]
  Siblings: State-Sponsored Propaganda, Conspiracy Theory Promotion
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#NonConsensualIntimateImagery: Non-Consensual Intimate Imagery — Creation, distribution, or threat of distributing sexually explicit images or videos without the depicted individual's consent. [found by 4/14 queries]
  Siblings: Child Sexual Exploitation, Sexual Exploitation Harassment, Sexual Coercion

axes.rationale: Sexual content is a specific type of toxic content that the AI might expose users to, as mentioned in the risk description.
Threats of violence are a form of toxic content that the AI might expose users to, aligning with the risk description.
